name: documents
description: PDF upload (multipart) and download (binary) with an API key.

input.title: Document Store API
input.requirements: A document store. A client uploads a PDF together with a title (as a multipart form with the fields file and title). A document has an id, a title, a size_bytes and an uploaded_at timestamp. Clients can list documents, fetch a document's details, download the PDF itself from /documents/{id}/content, and delete a document.
